items.title: You've Got A Friend (cover of James Trayor) - 1994 Australian Karaoke Music Video
items.description:
The entire series of these karaoke videos is almost beyond parody.

This video is from a karaoke DVD entitled "Everlasting Love Song, Volume 5", produced by Taiwanese production house Honstar/Glory Star. This would have been released originally on Laserdisc and VCD in the early 1990s.
